title: Address-variable encoding
statement: Let $a,j\in\mathbb{N}$. Define a map from six symbols to natural numbers by sending the current-address symbol to $a$, its successor symbol to $a+1$, the zero symbol to $0$, the one symbol to $1$, the address-$j$ symbol to $j$, and its successor symbol to $j+1$.
